info.title: Parsequerade
info.description: Implemented read routes, the scoped age-rating POST, and hosted connection setup and revocation. Hosted connections require operator-configured encrypted storage; operator-managed connections remain supported.

post.summary: Update an app's age rating declaration
post.description: Requires read and write capabilities. Proves the app-info belongs to the selected app, resolves its declaration ID, and sends one Apple PATCH without retrying. Only supplied attributes change. No query parameters or IDs are accepted. Unknown or deprecated fields and enum values are rejected. Questionnaire answers cannot be null. Optional override/text fields can be null to clear them. URL values must be HTTP(S) without embedded credentials. Apple decides whether the app state, key role, and combination of answers permit the update. On write_outcome_unknown (network, timeout, or malformed success response), read back before considering another POST.

requestBody.description: A flat nonempty subset of writable attributes, at most 8 KiB of JSON.

400.description: Invalid or unsupported attributes, values, or query parameters.

403.description: write_forbidden for read-only grants; upstream_forbidden for Apple permission denial.

404.description: The selected app-info or declaration was not found under this app.

post.description: Accept at most 8 KiB of JSON, validate an App Store Connect team key, probe read access, and return a facade key. Optional capabilities defaults to [read]; [read,write] enables the age-rating POST. Existing connections remain read-only until reconnected. The submitted private key is stored encrypted; provide it again only when creating a new connection.

requestBody.description: The complete JSON body must not exceed 8 KiB.

503.description: Hosted connection storage is unavailable or unconfigured.

delete.description: Remove the stored Apple credentials and revoke the facade key. Authenticate with the connection's facade API key.

204.description: Connection credentials removed and facade key revoked.

503.description: Hosted connection storage is unavailable or unconfigured.

capabilities.description: Must include read. Add write to enable the age-rating POST. Apple write permissions are checked when the POST executes.

apiKey.description: One-time bearer key; store it securely.
